text: DSH Annotation Patched 是面向 DSH Web 的文字引用批注插件。它通过浏览器客户端扩展助手回复和消息编辑区：选中回复中的片段后可添加引用与可选备注，引用会带编号高亮并按会话保存在浏览器中。发送消息时，插件把引用和备注整理成编号文本附在问题前，提示模型逐条回应，回复完成后再把编号显示为可悬停的引用芯片。用户还可查看、修改或删除待发送引用，并在支持的斜杠技能消息中保留引用。适合需要针对长回复中的具体段落追问的 DSH Web 用户；无需额外密钥或外部服务。

DSH Annotation Patched lets DSH Web users quote assistant passages, add notes, and save numbered annotations per session. It adds quotes to a message for the model to answer, then displays numbered reply chips. Users can review, edit, or delete pending quotes. No extra key or service is required.
想针对助手回复里的某一段文字继续提问，还能附上自己的备注吗？
让 DSH 把我选中的回答片段编号后一起发给模型逐条解释。
长回答里有几处不理解，想分别标出来再一次性追问。
我能不能给回复中的原文加引用标记，并在发送前编辑或删除？
刷新网页后保留还没发出去的引用，应该怎么做？
DSH Web 能在模型回复旁边显示引用原文的悬浮标记吗？
How can I ask about several selected passages in one message?
I want my DSH reply to include numbered quotes and optional notes.
@dsh-external/dsh-annotation-patched 的功能「选择回复片段并添加备注」：选中助手回复中的文字后出现批注按钮；用户可填写备注或留空保存纯引用，文本会被记录并加上编号标记。
@dsh-external/dsh-annotation-patched 的功能「随消息发送编号引用」：发送前插件把引用原文与备注整理为编号块并拼入消息草稿，提示模型逐项回应；支持 Enter 和发送按钮路径。
@dsh-external/dsh-annotation-patched 的功能「按会话保存待发送引用」：待发送引用按会话 ID 写入浏览器 localStorage，包含文本、备注和定位信息；重新载入后可恢复并继续编辑。
@dsh-external/dsh-annotation-patched 的功能「查看和管理引用清单」：编辑器旁显示待发送引用数量，悬停可查看各条内容和备注，并可删除条目；点击回复中的编号也能重新编辑备注。
@dsh-external/dsh-annotation-patched 的功能「回复编号转为悬浮引用芯片」：助手完成回复后，插件把 Annotation 编号转换为可悬停芯片，展示对应的引用片段与备注。
@dsh-external/dsh-annotation-patched 将待发送引用按会话存入浏览器 localStorage；清除站点数据会丢失内容，且不会跨浏览器或设备同步。（见 client.js:847-895）

@dsh-external/dsh-annotation-patched README · Summary：`dsh-annotation-patched` v0.3.7 adds selection annotation to the DSH Web client. Select text in an assistant reply, write an optional note, and press Enter to send the annotation block with your message. The model answers each annotation by number, and every numbered answer becomes a hoverable chip that shows the quoted passage. Pending annotations are stored per session, so they survive a page reload until you send or delete them.

@dsh-external/dsh-annotation-patched README · Table of Contents：- [Installation](#installation) - [Usage](#usage) - [Configuration](#configuration) - [How the plugin works](#how-the-plugin-works) - [Further Exploration](#further-exploration) - [Model Experience](#model-experience) - [Known Limitations and Deferred Work](#known-limitations-and-deferred-work) - [Dev Note](#dev-note) -----

@dsh-external/dsh-annotation-patched README · Installation：Install the package into the web profile from GitHub:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:DDDFXYqiming/dsh-annotation-patched
```

To install from a local checkout, clone the repository, install its development dependencies, and add the directory:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/DDDFXYqiming/dsh-annotation-patched.git
cd dsh-annotation-patched
npm install
dsh plugin --profile web add .

@dsh-external/dsh-annotation-patched README · Installation：The profile applies bundle changes at startup. Restart DSH after adding the package, then hard reload the Web page with Ctrl+F5 so the browser fetches the current client bundle. The package targets the Web client. Its Node entry registers the plugin identity with an empty `apply`, and the browser half loads through the client module table. -----

@dsh-external/dsh-annotation-patched README · Usage：1. Select text in an assistant reply. A small floating toolbar appears next to the selection with a single **Annotate** button (引用 in the Chinese UI).
2. Click the button. Write a note, or leave it empty to quote the passage without a note, then save.
3. The quoted text gets a numbered highlight, and a badge above the composer shows `Annotations ×N`. Hover the badge to review the list, click a number to edit its note, and delete entries from the editor.
4. Send with Enter, the send button, or Ctrl+Enter while the conversation is running. The plugin prepends the annotation block to your message before the host submits it.
5. The model is asked to answer `Annotation 1` through `Annotation N`. When the reply finishes streaming, each label becomes a hoverable chip that shows the quoted passage and your note.
6. A slash skill such as `/human-writing fix this` keeps the annotations. The plugin appends the annotation block after the command, and the host still loads the skill from the message. Built-in slash commands such as `/goal` and `/model` send without annotations; a toast says the annotations stay pending for the next message.

@dsh-external/dsh-annotation-patched README · Configuration：- Display language follows the DSH locale service. Both `zh` and `en` are available, and the plugin falls back to `zh` when the locale service is absent. The annotation block uses the same language as the UI. - Pending annotations live in browser `localStorage` under `dsh.annotation.pending.v1.`. - To disable the plugin, remove the package from the profile, or disable its loader entry id `dsh-annotation-patched` in the profile patch layer. -----

@dsh-external/dsh-annotation-patched README · How the plugin works：<details>
<summary>Implementation details (click to expand)</summary>

`index.mjs` is the Node half. It exports the package name and an empty `apply`; the real work happens in the browser.

`client.js` is a hand written CommonJS bundle wrapped in `window.__ModuleLoader__.load`. The registration id must equal the package name. The bundle renders its own DOM and imports no `@deepseek-ai` values. It receives `sessions`, `conversation`, and `locale` as cordis services.

@dsh-external/dsh-annotation-patched README · How the plugin works：`cordis.patch.yml` inserts the loader entry `dsh-annotation-patched` with `name` set to the package name. The id differs from the upstream `dsh-annotation` id so both packages can be installed at once. Later profile patches can override or disable the entry by id.

@dsh-external/dsh-annotation-patched README · How the plugin works：Selection capture: `selectionchange` opens the toolbar. Saving a quote records the message anchor key, the text offset, the surrounding context, the quoted text, and the note. The pending list is written to `localStorage` per session, and the source passage is decorated with an absolutely positioned highlight and number badge.

@dsh-external/dsh-annotation-patched README · How the plugin works：Sending: capture phase listeners cover Enter, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter, and the send button (pointer down and keyboard click). Before submitting, the plugin strips any leftover block from the draft with `stripOldBlock`, then prepends the protocol block. A pure quote with an empty draft is submitted directly with `submit('queue')`; when the draft has text, the event returns to the composer and the host decides between Queue and Steer. An IME latch prevents the Enter that confirms a composition from attaching the block.

@dsh-external/dsh-annotation-patched README · How the plugin works：Cleanup: pending quotes clear only when the draft goes from non-empty to empty, which marks a confirmed send. A decoration scan acts as a fallback, so a leftover block cannot attach to the next message.

Reply decoration: once streaming ends and `data-streaming` is gone, the plugin strips inline think blocks, then replaces `Annotation N` labels with chips. Items come from the nearest previous annotated user message. Rows are decorated again when the host rebuilds a queued message bubble.

@dsh-external/dsh-annotation-patched README · How the plugin works：Multiple composers: the composer DOM carries no session marker, so with more than one `[data-composer-card]` on screen the plugin leaves the draft untouched and lets the host send it.

Slash skills: a slash draft is checked against the `remote.skills` list, cached for 60 seconds. On a match, the plugin appends a head only block after the command. Built-in commands keep their original behavior.

@dsh-external/dsh-annotation-patched README · How the plugin works：Maintenance: `patches/manifest.json` records 81 anchored operations, and `scripts/apply-patches.mjs` replays them onto a clean upstream `client.js` after a global terminology rename. Every anchor must match exactly once, so an upstream change fails loudly instead of applying silently. `--expect` compares the result byte for byte with a known good artifact.

Tests: `npm run check` parses the entry files. `npm test` runs the offline DOM suite on `node:test` and jsdom.

@dsh-external/dsh-annotation-patched README · How the plugin works：Diagnostics: filter the browser console for `[annotation]`. The logs cover block attachment, slash skill attachment, reply chip decoration, and early exits. An early exit with pending quotes reports its reason. -----

- [`scripts/apply-patches.mjs`](scripts/apply-patches.mjs): replay tool for a new upstream base.
- [`patches/manifest.json`](patches/manifest.json): terminology mapping and anchored operations.

@dsh-external/dsh-annotation-patched README · Model Experience：The model sees the annotation block as plain text at the start of the user message. No system prompt or tool call is added. A message with one annotation and a follow-up question looks like this:

```
I annotated the following 1 passage(s) (the numbers match the quotes below); please respond to them when answering my question:

1. <quoted passage>
   Note: <your note>

A pure quote, meaning an empty draft, uses the shorter form below and has no `Ask:` marker:

@dsh-external/dsh-annotation-patched README · Model Experience：```
I annotated the following passages; please respond to each annotation:

1. <quoted passage>

The reply text keeps the `Annotation N` labels. The client turns them into chips in the DOM only, so the stored session keeps the original text.

@dsh-external/dsh-annotation-patched README · KV Cache effect：The block is part of one user message and is sent once. It is not injected into later requests, and earlier messages are never rewritten. The chips in a reply are a DOM presentation, so they add no request content. Provider prefix caching continues as for any new user message. Switching the DSH locale changes only blocks composed after the switch.

-----

@dsh-external/dsh-annotation-patched README · Known Limitations and Deferred Work：- Only assistant replies can be annotated. Text in user messages is not selectable for annotation.
- The plugin depends on DSH Web DOM attributes such as `[data-chat-flow-kind="assistant-step"]`, `[data-composer-card]`, `[data-composer-input]`, and `[data-chat-anchor-key]`. A UI change can break selection, attachment, or chip decoration.
- With more than one composer on screen, for example an Agent Teams panel or an embedded subagent view, the plugin refuses to attach annotations and sends the message unchanged. It cannot tell which session a composer belongs to.
- Slash skills need the `remote.skills` list. When the service is absent, the list has not arrived, or the fetch fails, that message is sent without annotations and the annotations stay pending. Built-in slash commands never carry annotations and show a toast instead.
- Inline think stripping matches literal `<think>`, `<thinking>`, `<thought>`, and `<reasoning>` tags in text nodes. When the host renders a tag as HTML and only the reasoning text remains, the plugin has nothing to match.
- Pending annotations are stored in browser `localStorag

@dsh-external/dsh-annotation-patched README · Dev Note：<details>
<summary>Maintainer context (click to expand)</summary>

`client.js` is edited directly and shipped as is. There is no build step; `npm run check` only parses the files.

When upstream publishes a new base version:

@dsh-external/dsh-annotation-patched README · Dev Note：1. Fetch the clean `client.js` with `gh api repos/omdsh-dev/dsh-annotation/contents/client.js?ref=<commit>`, or pass `--fetch <commit>` to the script.
2. Run `node scripts/apply-patches.mjs --fetch <commit> --out client.js --expect client.js`.
3. Adapt the `find` anchor of any failing op in `patches/manifest.json`, keeping its semantics, then rerun.
4. Run `npm run check && npm test`, then smoke test Enter, Ctrl+Enter, a slash skill, and a reload in DSH Web.

@dsh-external/dsh-annotation-patched README · Dev Note：The replay tool replays 81 anchored ops after the terminology rename from 批注 to 引用. Each anchor must match exactly once. Keep the `exports.name` in `client.js`, the package `name`, and the entry `name` in `cordis.patch.yml` identical.

`test/client-load.test.mjs` asserts that both READMEs carry the version from `package.json` and the op count from `patches/manifest.json`. Update both files together with the manifest.

@dsh-external/dsh-annotation-patched README · Dev Note：`npm test` needs Node >= 22.22.2 for jsdom 30. The Node range in `engines` describes the DSH host runtime instead.

</details>
